description: Cited review of the fields each original holdings source format reports. A field marked false is the publisher's absence, carried as a per-fund limitation; an archived original that reports it contradicts the review and fails acceptance.

SEC_NPORT_PRIMARY_XML.note: Form N-PORT Part C: Item C.1 reports issuer name, LEI, title, CUSIP and other identifiers; C.4 the asset and issuer category; C.5 the country of investment or issuer. There is no industry sector item.

ISHARES_UCITS_PRIMARY_CSV.note: Archived columns: Ticker, Name, Sector, Asset Class, Market Value, Weight (%), Notional Value, Shares, Price, Location, Exchange, Market Currency. No ISIN, CUSIP or LEI, and no NAV statement.

ISHARES_UCITS_ANNUAL_PRIMARY_PDF.note: Schedule of investments lists holding name, quantity, fair value and percentage of net assets, grouped by country; the statement of financial position gives NAV.

VANGUARD_UCITS_ORIGINAL_REPORT_PDF.note: Portfolio statement lists holding name, shares, market value and percentage of total net assets, grouped by country; the balance sheet gives NAV.
